SUMMIT ELECTRIC PARTNERS
Commercial & Industrial Electrical Construction - Suffolk, VA
PROPOSAL SUMMARY
Proposal Date: October 6, 2026
Submitted To: Crestmark Construction Partners
Attention: Melissa Tran, Senior Estimator
Project: Westbrook Logistics Center
Project Number: 28-0355
Bid Package: 28-0355-BP-26 - Division 26 Electrical
Base Bid: $214,500.00
Bid Validity: 30 calendar days from the Proposal Date
Based on Contract Drawings Revision 1 and the Project Manual issued for bid.

SUMMIT ELECTRIC PARTNERS
SCOPE OF WORK
Included in our Base Bid of $214,500.00:
1 Electrical mobilization and supervision.
2 Warehouse power distribution and panelboards per the Contract Drawings.
3 High-bay lighting fixtures and controls throughout the warehouse floor.
4 Dock leveler and dock equipment power connections at all dock positions shown.
5 Emergency and egress lighting per the Contract Drawings and applicable code.
6 Electrical permit fees associated with our Division 26 scope of work.
7 Fire alarm device connections shown on the electrical Contract Drawings.
Summit Electric Partners - Westbrook Logistics Center, Project 28-0355, Bid Package 28-0355-BP-26

SUMMIT ELECTRIC PARTNERS
CLARIFICATIONS AND EXCLUSIONS
The following is excluded from our Base Bid:
1 Performance and payment bond. Available as an add-alternate if required by Crestmark.
2 Utility transformer coordination and metering - by others, coordinated directly with the utility.
An arc-flash hazard study is not addressed in this proposal; please advise if this is required as a deliverable under our contract or is being retained separately by Crestmark.

SUMMIT ELECTRIC PARTNERS
COMMERCIAL AND SCHEDULE TERMS
Anticipated duration is 14 weeks from mobilization, subject to an approved project schedule. This proposal remains valid for 30 calendar days from the Proposal Date stated on Page 1.
Respectfully submitted,
Anthony Ruiz
Senior Estimator, Summit Electric Partners
anthony.ruiz@summit-electric-demo.example

award.narrative: Recommend award to Summit Electric Partners at $224,500 leveled, scoring 92.3 of 100, ahead of Gridline Power Solutions at 74.7 (17.6 points). This is also the lowest leveled bid. It is not the lowest submitted bid: Gridline Power Solutions submitted $189,900 but rises to $233,500 once excluded scope is priced. Strongest factor is leveled cost at 100 of 100 ($224,500 leveled, the lowest leveled bid); weakest is experience and past performance at 79 (3.0% change-order rate, 91% on-time closeout, 5 package(s) completed over 6 years). 1 bidder(s) were excluded before scoring: Anchor Electrical Co. ($10,050 above the recommendation) -- Bid of $234,550 exceeds the usable single-project limit of $225,000 (10% headroom on a $250,000 limit). Weights applied: leveled cost 40%, experience and past performance 30%, safety record 20%, schedule and capacity 10%.

prequalification.policy_note: Safety and insurance are gates, not weights. A subcontractor over the EMR maximum or under a required insurance limit is removed from award consideration before price is discussed, because carrying that risk is not something a lower number buys back.

coverage.policy_note: A package with fewer than three responsive bidders is not competitively bid, and the leveled spread stops being evidence of a market price. Coverage is tracked from the invitation out, not from the bids in, because the bids that never arrived are the ones that do not show up in any comparison.
